title: Independently replay and audit PR627 factored cold ends
body:
Adds an independent, reproducible audit of Jeremy Diviney’s PR627 at `f95308a9afa5adc071fe75c8cd7feec172503d4f`. A fresh strict replay passes all 64 stages and reproduces conditional κ = **408937459514291/250000000000000000 = 0.001635749838057164**, with no reused baseline or provider outputs.

The separate checker reconstructs native forward/backward profiles, verifies all 35,424 owner roles and compact intervals, and recomputes the moment using the retained PR626 rational interval engine. The contributor’s 14 focused raw-word corruptions plus four additional tail/sign corruptions are rejected, as are four independent owner-check corruptions. Recipe, word and owner exporters reproduce the exact decompressed inputs. All 23 core files are identical to retained PR623.

The package preserves the frozen source with original notices, raw replay evidence, source correspondence, deterministic-export receipts, added checkers and a hash inventory. Its replay wrapper validates the frozen source hash before extraction. The contribution credits Jeremy Diviney, Jeremy Kothe, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Chafik Boukhalfa and the inherited notices, and discloses Chi Zhao’s substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Scope: finite conditional construction audit only. PR543’s bit supplier is cited and repriced, not rebuilt. No selected-certificate update, full multiplication theorem, Linux CI pass, full repository-suite pass or optimality claim. Newer PR629 and PR632 are outside this audit.

The packaged wrapper also passed a second complete fresh 64-stage replay (337.80 seconds), the separate checker and all 18 focused controls. Its result matches the first run except timing. All 131 retained-file hashes were checked after final packaging.

Validation details and exact receipts are in `research/pr627-independent-audit-20261013/README.md` and `VERIFIED.json`.

```sh
PYTHON=python3 sh research/pr627-independent-audit-20261013/run_replay.sh /tmp/pr627-fresh-review
```

Python 3.10+; the work directory must be new. This contribution is separate from the E8 research theorem in #631 and E6 census correction in #630.
